subject: Input problems with plot function. How to fix

messages.author: c944e424fd78eae4
messages.subject: Input problems with plot function. How to fix
parts:
https://shiny.as.uky.edu/bracket/

I have built a shiny app for our Statistics Department Basketball Pool. We have been running it for the last three years this way and haven't had problems with input lag until this year. 

Some users (no specific problems by browser type), have issues when they advance teams in the bracket. They get so far and then the app crashes. Out of our 170 entries this year around 25 were having consistent problems. I tried to reproduce the problem and have had problems on a laptop (connected via wifi) but not on my desktop (hard wired). This past year we moved the server to https from http. Could this be the problem. If you need to look at the code for the shiny app, I can send a personal email. 

Thank you.
